text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but gains alone are not a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding’s prospects and my overall allocation.","A stock’s average cost and whether it is above or below my purchase price should not determine my decision; those are backward-looking reference points.","With prices moving randomly and my infrequent trading, I should avoid reacting to short-term account changes and make deliberate decisions based on risk and long-term goals."]}
